en-US.title: Pleiad: The Living Map
en-US.subtitle: Your people, across systems
en-US.description:
Pleiad maps the people in your life across humanity's symbolic traditions — side by side, without claiming any one of them is the truth.

Add the people who matter — partner, family, friends — and Pleiad renders each of them through six systems: Dreamspell galactic signatures, the Tzolkin count, the Mayan Long Count, Human Design bodygraphs, Western astrology, and Hebrew gematria. Then it goes further: tap any two people to explore how the traditions read their bond.

THE TODAY BOARD
Open the app to a single daily board: today's kin, moon phase, tropical and sidereal sun, Human Design gate, and the date across the Hebrew, Hijri, Persian, and Chinese calendars, with the Vedic panchang and the Long Count still ticking underneath.

THE MAP
Your people arranged as a living constellation — zoom, filter, tap into anyone, compare any two. Galactic birthdays surface when someone's kin returns.

EDUCATION, NOT DOGMA
Every system ships with its history, cultural context, and how the math actually works. Pleiad presents traditions respectfully and lets you decide what they mean to you. For reflection, education, and entertainment.

Your data stays yours. Birth details you add are used only to compute charts.
